2014_spells.druid-grove.description: You invoke the natural world to protect a natural area, such as a clearing in a forest or a hilltop. The area can be a hemisphere with a radius of up to 60 feet, or a 90-foot cube, depending on the terrain. The spell's area must be natural terrain or natural structures, such as trees, caves, or rock formations. The spell creates the following effects within the area. The entire warded area is under the effect of a pass without trace spell. A plant growth spell makes plants in the area dense and overgrown. In the area's interior, the spell creates the following additional effects: 1. At the area's center, a small shelter of trees and other plants forms, providing a comfortable resting place for up to eight Medium creatures. 2. Throughout the area, the spell creates a subtle ward against enchantment and illusion magic. Any creature that enters the area with hostile intent must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by you for the duration, treating you as a friendly acquaintance. This effect ends if the charmed creature takes damage or if you or your allies do anything harmful to it. 3. The spell creates a subtle ward against magical sensors and scrying attempts. The area is under the effect of a nondetection spell. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures who can pass into and out of the area without its effects.
2014_spells.druid-grove.effectSummary: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.druid-grove.fullDescription: Using 10 minutes, you invoke the natural world to protect a natural area, such as a clearing in a forest or a hilltop. Any creature that enters the area with hostile intent must make a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC against your spell save spell save DC; The area can be a hemisphere with a radius of up to 60 feet, or a 90-foot cube, depending on the terrain. This effect ends if the charmed creature takes damage or if you or your allies do anything harmful to it.
